greenhouse-single.method: Finite per-channel values; left-closed/right-open receive-time windows; sample SD.

heating_fit.method: Fixed measured baseline; least-squares amplitude for each positive tau; ternary search.

puck-light.method: Finite per-channel values; left-closed/right-open receive-time windows; sample SD.

cc2541-accelerometer.method: Finite per-channel values; left-closed/right-open receive-time windows; sample SD.

cc2541-gyroscope.method: Finite per-channel values; left-closed/right-open receive-time windows; sample SD.

cc2541-magnetometer.method: Finite per-channel values; left-closed/right-open receive-time windows; sample SD.

cc2541-humidity.method: Finite per-channel values; left-closed/right-open receive-time windows; sample SD.

cc2541-pressure.method: Finite per-channel values; left-closed/right-open receive-time windows; sample SD.

cc2541-ir-temperature.method: Finite per-channel values; left-closed/right-open receive-time windows; sample SD.

pocketlab-gyroscope.method: Finite per-channel values; left-closed/right-open receive-time windows; sample SD.

sensortag-environmental.method: Native windows on each clock. Nearest-neighbour temperature diagnostic only within 0.5s. Magnus vapor pressure from simultaneous HDC T/RH.

static-friction.method: Left-closed/right-open windows; raw-component angle; previous gravity timestamp; no SEM from adjacent rows.

audio-magnetic.method: Each stream windowed on own session timestamps; 1 s transition exclusion. N-weighted mean square then dB. Three cycle contrasts, not adjacent samples, describe cycle spread. No lag/coherence inference.

magnetic-current.method: Assigned protocol current levels, not an independent measured current channel. Windows omit 1 s after and before each 8 s step; final zero uses49--55 s. Ascending fit uses five plateau means. Endpoint calibration uses1--7 and33--39 s. Row scatter not replicate uncertainty.

pressure-boiling.method: All paired rows; code 1 only for ln(p) vs 1/T OLS
pressure-boiling.saturation_reference: IAPWS SR1-86(1992), page3 Eq1; bisection inversion

spectral-fingerprints.method: Dark-subtracted ratios at each common wavelength; 595nm local baseline=(580+610)/2
spectral-fingerprints.uncertainties: Only wavelength standard uncertainty is present (0.2nm); no intensity uncertainty supplied

coronagraph-contrast.method: Two observations per mask/separation; ratios of group means for contrast
coronagraph-contrast.uncertainty_note: ROI difference uncertainties retained; combining two rows presumes independent errors

uv-transmission.method: Interior half-open windows in device time; separate receive clock; single-reading SD uncertainty illustration
uv-transmission.clock_note: receive-device offset is not measured network latency without synchronized clock origins
uv-transmission.calibration_note: Absolute scale conditional on entered coefficients; no coefficient uncertainty available

rgb-filter-transmission.windows: Half-open device-time intervals; local extrema are transitions, not plateaux

illuminance-distance.method: Most recent actual mouse receive time, then unweighted log-log fit of plateau means

illuminance-distance-manual.method: Two-second interior means versus one paired snapshot per ruler position; log OLS

malus-law.method: Linear least squares in 1,cos(2 theta),sin(2 theta); phase and amplitude recovered algebraically

colour-temperature.method: Dark-correct raw counts; normalize by corrected clear; donor matrix; guarded McCamy cubic
colour-temperature.calibration_scope: Donor matrix comes from TCS3414CS application note, not an APDS calibration

detector-characterization.method: Actual timestamp differences; summary cross-check; interior event windows; all 16 stride phases

clocks.method: Adjacent differences within each clock; no clock alignment.

nano-transit.interpretation: Depth scatter across three events, not a sample-count standard error.

clocks.method: Adjacent differences within each clock; no clock alignment.

exomoon-photometry.uncertainty_note: Quadrature of state one-second block SDs / (baseline-10); fluctuation scale, not confidence interval for a mean.

clocks.method: Adjacent differences within each clock; no clock alignment.

starspot-crossing.note: One-second blocks describe fluctuation; control is a separate depth comparison, not evidence for equal occulted area.

clocks.method: Adjacent differences within each clock; no clock alignment.

eclipsing-binary.note: Intervals share endpoints; SD is descriptive, not uncertainty of independent replicated periods. Adopted background 10 counts.

clocks.method: Adjacent differences within each clock; no clock alignment.

seasons-obliquity.note: Twelve distinct labelled settings, one snapshot each; no independent replicate uncertainty. Each snapshot checked against raw acquisition.
